usedFor: Clio holds client contacts, and Gmail sends the mail, so “New Contact” in Clio can start “Send Email” in Gmail.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in Clio, then “Send Email” in Gmail
bestTemplate.why: A new client record gets a first email from your Gmail account without anyone retyping the address.

watchOut: An email to a client waits in Needs you for approval before “Send Email” in Gmail goes out.
